articles.summary: In addition to this prestigious global recognition, Milwaukee’s iconic hotel also was named the number one hotel in the Midwest The Pfister Hotel , owned and managed by Marcus® Hotels Resorts has been named by readers of Conde Nast Traveler as the No. 24 Best Hotel in the World. The 2026 Condé Nast Traveler Readers’ Choice Awards are one of the travel industry’s most prestigious and longest-running recognitions. The Pfister also earned #1 Best Hotel in the Midwest . The recognition places The Pfister among an international collection of celebrated hotels in destinations including Japan, Thailand, New York City, Dubai and Hong Kong. For Milwaukee’s historic luxury hotel to earn a place among the world’s top 50 underscores the city’s growing presence on the global hospitality stage, alongside some of the most renowned travel destinations in the world. articles.summary: Marcus Corporation (NYSE: MCS) today announced it will report results for the third quarter of 2026 prior to the stock market open on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The release will be followed by a conference call at 10:00 a.m. Central/11:00 a.m. Eastern time. Participants may listen to the call live on the internet through the investor relations section of the company's website: investors.marcuscorp.com , or by dialing 1-626-884-3620 and entering the meeting ID 600793939. Listeners should dial in to the call at least 5-10 minutes prior to the start of the call or should go to the website at least 15 minutes prior to the call to download and install any necessary audio software. A replay of the conference call will be archived on the company’s website until its next earnings release.
